root_cause.text: The PM runtime resume call (pm_runtime_resume_and_get) was placed inside the job execution workqueue handler (aie2_sched_job_run), which deadlocks with the runtime suspend callback that drains the same workqueue before suspending the device.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves pm_runtime_resume_and_get from aie2_sched_job_run to the job submission routine (amdxdna_cmd_submit) and moves the corresponding pm_runtime_suspend_put from aie2_sched_notify and error paths to the job cleanup function (amdxdna_sched_job_cleanup). The commit message explicitly states: "If a job is still executing and calls pm_runtime_resume_and_get(), it can deadlock with the runtime suspend path."
